title: Overlap Finder
one_liner: Paste your subscription list and see which tools an AI-assistant workspace could replace and the potential monthly savings.
headline: List your SaaS tools and seats, get an instant 'replace / partial / keep' verdict against an AI workspace with reasons, running savings, and a printable migration checklist.

episode.title: Jensen’s Departure, NVIDIA’s succession plan, AI doomer response, and Demis talks RSI | MOONSHOTS #311 (recorded live)

history.summary: A clean, honestly-labeled audit tool that matches both the episode idea and the Seat Shed opportunity: real user-entered data drives every verdict and total, the rule table and the 50% partial-credit math are clearly disclosed as editable estimates rather than measurements, and all five acceptance criteria check out against the code and screenshots. The main gap is usefulness-at-scale — a genuine 15+ tool audit means adding each tool one at a time with no paste/CSV shortcut, which the demo spec implies should exist.
